name: speech-cpp
description: Umbrella port over the QVAC speech stack with one shared ggml dependency and selectable whisper, parakeet, TTS, and audiogen engines. Revision #1 of 2026-09-15 advances the shared source pin from a976c4d6 to 0d4ba2b3 (qvac-fabric-speech.cpp PR #254: Apple Core ML sidecar for the Audio8 codec synthesis stack behind TTS_CPP_COREML, presence-driven on <codec-decoder>.mlmodelc next to the decoder GGUF, plus tts_cpp::audio8::Engine::codec_on_coreml()) and widens the coreml feature to every engine with a sidecar (PARAKEET_COREML, TTS_CPP_COREML, AUDIOGEN_COREML) instead of implying parakeet. No ggml-speech change.

audiogen.description: Build the audiogen engine (ACE-Step music generation) from engines/audiogen. CMake package: find_package(audiogen-cpp CONFIG) + audiogen-cpp::audiogen-cpp.

coreml.description: Enable the Apple Core ML (Neural Engine) sidecars of every enabled engine that has one: the Parakeet FastConformer encoder (PARAKEET_COREML), the Audio8 codec synthesis stack in tts (TTS_CPP_COREML) and the ACE-Step VAE decoder in audiogen (AUDIOGEN_COREML). All presence-driven at runtime: each engine runs its stage on a compiled .mlmodelc found next to the model file and falls back to ggml when it is absent. Combine with the engine features you build; this feature no longer implies parakeet.

cuda.description: Enable CUDA GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Linux / Windows on NVIDIA, via ggml-speech[cuda]). Needs nvcc on the build host; at runtime CUDA engages only where the NVIDIA driver and the CUDA 13 runtime libraries (cudart, cuBLAS) both resolve, and devices without compiled kernels are skipped in favor of Vulkan or CPU.

metal.description: Enable Metal GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (macOS / iOS, via ggml-speech[metal]).

opencl.description: Enable OpenCL GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Android / Adreno, via ggml-speech[opencl]).

parakeet.description: Build the Parakeet engine (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR: CTC / TDT / EOU, Nemotron 3.5, plus Sortformer diarization) from engines/parakeet. CMake package: find_package(qvac-parakeet CONFIG) + qvac::parakeet.

tts.description: Build the TTS engine collection from engines/tts: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Pocket TTS, Audio8 and LavaSR speech enhancement, as one library. CMake package: find_package(tts-cpp CONFIG) + tts-cpp::tts-cpp.

vulkan.description: Enable Vulkan GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Linux / Windows / Android; Apple platforms use the metal feature instead, via ggml-speech[vulkan]).

whisper.description: Build the whisper engine from third_party/whisper.cpp (upstream whisper.cpp with the QVAC delta; upstream's bundled parakeet is gated off). CMake package: find_package(whisper CONFIG) + whisper::whisper.
